title: About Kaizena Life
story: About us: We are a Norwegian-based called HumanWeb. As part of the AI revolution, we created KaizenaLabs as a mission-driven initiative to stay on top of the development, and to leverage the new technology to uplift and enhance peoples' lives with AI by their side. That ended up becoming this app, The Kaizen Life Tracker.

What makes this this app different is that bridges all aspects of both your personal and work life. The founder, André Giæver, saw the need in his own life to have one coherent space to manage personal everyday stuff, his entrepreneurial side-hustles, and to organize his 9 to 5 day job.

The Kaizen Life Tracker became the answer. An AI-native ecosystem that covers all aspects of life, integrates with all common tools and services, and that is managed together with your personal, configurable AI agent. This agent learns about who you are, your life, your preferences, your goals. It works proactively to simplify your life by off-loading and automating tasks, monitor progress in areas such as health, finance, everyday logistics, etc. All of it. The app adapts and scales based on your needs.
